thread.title: Thursday's ETF with Unusual Volume: IGM

author: BNK Invest
title: Thursday's ETF with Unusual Volume: IGM
text:
Shutterstock photo The iShares North American Tech ETF ( IGM ) is seeing unusually high volume in afternoon trading Thursday, with over 272,000 shares traded versus three month average volume of about 52,000. Shares of IGM were up about 1.4% on the day.
Components of that ETF with the highest volume on Thursday were Apple ( AAPL ), trading up about 3.2% with over 51.1 million shares changing hands so far this session, and Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ), up about 1.2% on volume of over 43.9 million shares. Trimble ( TRMB ) is the component faring the best Thursday, up by about 15.2% on the day, while Veeco Instruments ( VECO ) is lagging other components of the iShares North American Tech ETF, trading lower by about 18.3%.
